core_thesis_question: Is a low-cost predicted impact scope functionally sufficient for correct, preservation-safe LLM-driven software evolution, and what is the effect of enforcing that scope as a hard editing contract?
causal_principle: hold task, parent repo, task spec, generator/model, temperature/config, repair policy, validator, evaluation oracle fixed; change ONLY the scope contract

GOLD_HARD.editable_scope: observed target-changed SOURCE files only; tests excluded
GOLD_HARD.purpose: feasibility ceiling / scope upper reference, not deployable method

AGENT_HARD.purpose: matched comparator using Agent file selection under the same downstream generator/validator

PLACEBO_HARD.editable_scope: size-matched random source-file set with exactly |RMCSS_HARD| files; fixed seed; same eligible parent-only source universe; no test/vendor/generated files; selected without gold/RM-CSS/Agent/E2E outcome

RMCSS_SOFT.editable_scope: RM-CSS predicted files provided as starting context/hints; editing NOT restricted
RMCSS_SOFT.purpose: directly test the scientific effect of the HARD selective-regeneration contract vs the same localizer as a soft navigation hint

GOLD_MINUS_ONE.editable_scope: subset only; tasks with >=2 and bounded gold source files; remove one gold source file, everything else fixed
GOLD_MINUS_ONE.purpose: causal Critical Omission Risk; NOT a primary all-task arm; bounded cost/sample plan

assay_sensitivity.requirement: a future RMCSS ~= Agent functionally result is interpretable only if the instrument can show that scope matters
pilot_must_demonstrate: Gold/meaningful scope is not indistinguishable from random placebo merely because the generator has a floor effect
the generator can solve a non-trivial fraction of confirmed tasks
assay_sensitivity.numeric_pilot_threshold: NOT invented in this mission; set from confirmed oracle yield, task strata, environment success, future Smoke/Pilot runtime, zero-API power/sensitivity scenarios

specification_policy.reason: target-derived signatures can make an under-specified task easier using privileged future information, changing the question; FEA-Bench provides signatures as part of its benchmark contract, our benchmark has a different task contract

spec_augmented_sensitivity.status: prepare but do not silently activate
spec_augmented_sensitivity.label: SPEC_AUGMENTED_SENSITIVITY
spec_augmented_sensitivity.rule: frozen before Research Run; must identify parent-available/public vs target-derived/oracle-assisted information

never_seen_by_generator: test expected outputs beyond the task spec

migration_policy.rule: identical deterministic post-processing allowed only if available to EVERY arm and outputs obey that arm's edit-scope contract; otherwise migration generation is part of the generator's responsibility

repetition_policy.test_oracle: 3 runs per parent state and 3 runs per target state
repetition_policy.llm_generation: do NOT force >=3 replicates per arm/task yet; Pilot estimates run-to-run variance and cost first; Research Run replicate count preregistered from Pilot evidence

estimands_planned: total pipeline cost (selection + generation + validation + repair)
per-arm pooled and stratified estimates with paired bootstrap CIs across confirmed oracle tasks
